local.name: Local (OpenAI API)
local.performance_note: Use any service that exposes OpenAI-style /chat/completions; fill in base URL, model name, and API key.
local.description: Connect to any AI service compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API. Provide the base URL (e.g. https://api.example.com/v1), model name, and API key from your provider. API key can be left empty if your local service does not require authentication.
local.token_link: Obtain API key from your provider

ollama.name: Local (Ollama)
ollama.performance_note: Local LLM runner with full offline capability; supports any open-source model (e.g. qwen, llama3, mistral) pulled via Ollama.
ollama.description: Ollama runs open-source models locally (no API key required). Set url to your Ollama server (default http://localhost:11434; use another host/port if needed). The model field can be any model name from 'ollama list' (e.g. qwen, llama3, llama3.2, mistral, gemma). Ensure Ollama is running and the chosen model is pulled (ollama pull <model>).

anthropic_local.name: Local (Anthropic)
anthropic_local.performance_note: Self-hosted Anthropic Claude API; requires local Claude API server.
anthropic_local.description: Connect to a locally hosted Anthropic Claude API server. Set the base URL to your local Claude API endpoint (e.g., http://localhost:8081). API key is optional for local deployments. Supports Claude 3 series models for high-quality translation with exceptional reasoning capabilities.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.performance_note: Industry-leading LLM with exceptional multilingual translation capabilities
openai.description: OpenAI's GPT series represents the cutting-edge of large language models, delivering superior performance in translation tasks across multiple language pairs with high accuracy and strong contextual understanding.

azure.name: Azure OpenAI
azure.performance_note: Enterprise-grade GPT service with high availability and security
azure.description: Microsoft Azure's OpenAI service provides enterprise-grade GPT models with enhanced security, compliance, and high availability, making it ideal for business-critical translation applications.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.performance_note: Exceptional at complex reasoning and long document processing
anthropic.description: Anthropic's Claude series excels in complex reasoning and long-context processing, making it particularly effective for translating lengthy documents with nuanced content and maintaining consistency across extended texts.

google.name: Google Gemini
google.performance_note: Multimodal model with excellent multilingual support and cost-effectiveness
google.description: Google's Gemini is a multimodal large language model that excels in multilingual understanding and generation, supporting over 100 languages with fast translation speeds and competitive pricing.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.performance_note: High-performance Chinese LLM with excellent Chinese-English translation capabilities
deepseek.description: DeepSeek's advanced language models demonstrate exceptional performance in Chinese language understanding and generation, with particularly strong Chinese-English translation quality at competitive pricing.

dashscope.name: Alibaba DashScope
dashscope.performance_note: Alibaba's Qwen series with strong Chinese processing and fast response times
dashscope.description: Alibaba's Qwen series of language models excel in Chinese text processing and multilingual translation, offering rapid response times and specialized optimization for Chinese language tasks.

volcengine_ark.name: VolcEngine ARK
volcengine_ark.performance_note: ByteDance's multimodal AI with excellent Chinese language capabilities
volcengine_ark.description: ByteDance's Doubao series represents a cutting-edge multimodal AI platform with exceptional Chinese language understanding and generation capabilities, supporting multilingual translation with specialized optimization for Chinese language tasks.

zhipu.name: Zhipu AI
zhipu.performance_note: Tsinghua-backed GLM series with strong academic foundation and high translation quality
zhipu.description: Zhipu AI's GLM series, backed by Tsinghua University's research excellence, delivers superior performance in academic and formal document translation with particularly high quality in Chinese-English language pairs.

groq.name: Groq
groq.performance_note: Ultra-fast inference with high-performance hardware acceleration
groq.description: Groq provides ultra-fast AI inference using custom hardware acceleration, delivering exceptional speed for real-time translation tasks with competitive accuracy.

together.name: Together AI
together.performance_note: Open-source model aggregation platform with competitive pricing
together.description: Together AI provides access to various open-source models including Llama, offering competitive pricing and good performance for multilingual translation tasks.

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.performance_note: European AI company with strong multilingual capabilities
mistral.description: Mistral AI's models excel in multilingual understanding and generation, particularly strong in European languages with competitive performance in translation tasks.

cohere.name: Cohere
cohere.performance_note: Enterprise-focused AI with strong reasoning and multilingual support
cohere.description: Cohere's Command series models excel in enterprise applications with strong reasoning capabilities and comprehensive multilingual support for business translation needs.

xai.name: xAI
xai.performance_note: Elon Musk's AI company with advanced reasoning capabilities
xai.description: xAI's Grok models provide advanced reasoning capabilities with strong multilingual understanding, designed for complex translation tasks requiring contextual awareness.

siliconflow.name: SiliconFlow
siliconflow.performance_note: Chinese AI service provider with competitive pricing
siliconflow.description: SiliconFlow provides access to various AI models including Qwen series, offering competitive pricing and good performance for Chinese language translation tasks.

dmxapi.name: DMX API
dmxapi.performance_note: Chinese API gateway providing access to various AI models
dmxapi.description: DMX API is a Chinese API gateway service that provides access to various AI models including GPT-4o, offering competitive pricing for Chinese users.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.performance_note: Universal API gateway for multiple AI models
openrouter.description: OpenRouter provides a unified API gateway to access multiple AI models from different providers, offering flexibility and competitive pricing for various translation needs.

hunyuan.name: Hunyuan
hunyuan.performance_note: Tencent's enterprise-grade model with high stability and reliability
hunyuan.description: Tencent's Hunyuan series provides enterprise-grade AI services with exceptional stability and reliability, making it ideal for large-scale translation operations and mission-critical applications.

baidu.name: Baidu ERNIE
baidu.performance_note: Baidu's ERNIE series with strong Chinese understanding and multimodal capabilities
baidu.description: Baidu's ERNIE series excels in Chinese language understanding and generation with advanced multimodal processing capabilities, making it particularly effective for Chinese language translation tasks.

moonshot.name: Moonshot AI
moonshot.performance_note: Moonshot AI specializes in long-context processing with stable translation quality
moonshot.description: Moonshot AI's models are specifically designed for long-context processing, delivering consistent and reliable translation quality for extended documents across multiple language pairs.

aleph_alpha.name: Aleph Alpha (Germany)
aleph_alpha.performance_note: German AI company with strong European language processing capabilities
aleph_alpha.description: Aleph Alpha's Luminous series models excel in European language processing, particularly suitable for German, French and other European language translations.

rinna.name: Rinna (Japan)
rinna.performance_note: Japanese AI company with excellent Japanese language processing capabilities
rinna.description: Rinna's Japanese-specific AI models excel in Japanese language understanding and generation, particularly suitable for Japanese translation tasks.

naver.name: Naver HyperClova (Korea)
naver.performance_note: Korean NAVER company with excellent Korean language processing capabilities
naver.description: NAVER's HyperClova series models excel in Korean language understanding and generation, particularly suitable for Korean translation tasks.

mineru.name: MinerU (Cloud)
mineru.performance_note: Advanced document parsing and conversion service with OCR capabilities
mineru.description: MinerU is a powerful document parsing service that converts various document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) into structured markdown format with high accuracy and OCR support.

mineru_local.name: MinerU (Local)
mineru_local.description: Locally deployed MinerU (v3.1+). Set base URL matching your mineru-api startup port (e.g., http://localhost:8920). The port number depends on your mineru-api configuration. API key is optional for local deployment.
